fields.Name: T214 - Developer Tools Event Monitor Pause and Clear Controls
fields.Description: Exercises the live-capture control state machine (TogglePause/Clear + LIVE/PAUSED indicator), a deterministic behavior no other inspector has and not covered by any render-only test.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'Event Monitor'. Observe the live status indicator reads 'LIVE' (capturing events) and a 'Total captured' counter. Click the 'Pause' button and confirm the status flips to 'PAUSED' (Capture suspended) and the button now offers 'Resume'; click 'Resume' to return to LIVE. Then click the 'Clear' button and confirm the in-buffer count resets. Success is these capture controls responding correctly. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Event Monitor shows a LIVE/PAUSED status and captured-event stats
Clicking Pause switches the status to PAUSED and the control to Resume (and Resume restores LIVE); Clear resets the buffered-event count
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
